info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Education Enrollments Waitlists-v2-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollment Waitlist Retrieval API provides a mechanism for users to access and view the current waitlist for various educational programs. This endpoint allows educational institutions and administrators to monitor student enrollment status and manage waitlisted candidates effectively. Use cases typically include checking student positions on waitlists, analyzing enrollment trends, and facilitating communication with potential students. This API supports higher education bodies, training providers, and other stakeholders in optimizing enrollment processes and resource allocation.

get.summary: Retrieve the list of students on the waitlist.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a current list of students who are on the waitlist for course enrollments. Use this to monitor waitlist status and manage student expectations.
